PGP Glass manufactures specialty glass packaging for sectors including specialty food and beverage. Credit: Svittlana/ Shutterstock.com.

Brookfield has agreed to purchase PGP Glass from funds managed by Blackstone Private Equity for $1.7bn.

The asset manager will finance the purchase through Brookfield Capital Partners, its flagship private equity strategy, alongside its affiliate, Brookfield Business.

Its industrial capabilities span the complete product lifecycle, including design, mould-making, specialty glass manufacturing, decoration, and packaging.

Industrial assets comprise three facilities situated across India and Sri Lanka.

Across these sites, the company operates 13 furnaces yielding an aggregate output exceeding 1,800 tonnes per day.

The manufacturer relies on an international logistics and warehousing network to distribute containers to corporate clients in more than 70 countries.

Cross-border activity accounts for over 70% of total revenue.

PGP Glass CEO Vijay Shah said: “Brookfield’s global footprint and substantial experience managing businesses across cycles will be particularly useful to us. We are grateful for Blackstone’s partnership, which helped us expand capacity, strengthen our operations and sustainability leadership, and grow ahead of the industry.”

Following the acquisition, the incoming ownership group plans to expand output through dedicated investments in manufacturing capacity, broader geographical reach, and increased volume allocations from existing client accounts.

Capital will also be deployed towards an enterprise-wide AI programme focused on operations, with specific implementations planned for sales and operations planning, production efficiency, and quality control.

The transaction is scheduled for completion in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory and government clearances.

Brookfield Asia Pacific and Middle East managing partner and private equity head Aditya Joshi said: “PGP is a high-quality manufacturer of specialty glass packaging, with a leadership position in premium categories and long-standing relationships with some of the world’s most recognisable brands.

“As demand for high-quality packaging continues to increase worldwide, Brookfield brings the scale and operating expertise to accelerate PGP’s growth through an AI-led transformation programme.”
